title: Congo Ebola Outbreak: Merck Ervebo Vaccine, Gilead Remdesivir Eyed for Wider Use
title_cn: 刚果埃博拉疫情：默克 Ervebo 疫苗和吉利德瑞德西韦有望更广泛使用
summary: Merck & Co.’s Ebola vaccine and an antiviral drug from Gilead Sciences Inc. are set for wider use in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo to blunt the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record.

title: Iran Wants to Bar US, Israeli Ships From Hormuz in Peace Accord
title_cn: 伊朗希望根据和平协议禁止美国和以色列船只驶出霍尔木兹海峡
summary: Iran will seek to bar US and Israeli ships from the Strait of Hormuz and require compensation from hostile countries before they’re allowed to sail through it, according to local media reports on a proposed Iran-Oman deal to manage the crucial waterway.

title: Xi Flexes Growing Legal Arsenal to Warn Trump Before Summit
title_cn: 习近平在峰会前利用日益强大的法律手段警告特朗普
summary: China’s latest barrage of countermeasures against the US drew on an expanding legal arsenal, demonstrating Beijing’s growing capacity to retaliate while warning Washington against further tech curbs before Xi Jinping’s expected visit next month.
